pokedexEntries.la: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

pokedexEntries.sc: This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its comrades who perished during a punishing journey to the river of their birth.

pokedexEntries.vi: It can jump with incredible power. Parts of its body are tinged red by the rage of its fallen friends.
